title: Lab production service skeleton
objective: A release candidate needs explicit adapter, loopback fixture binding, shutdown hooks and bounded error exposure.
misconception: The practice API binds publicly on 0.0.0.0 and lacks a shutdown hook.
acceptance: Boot a Nest Fastify app only on 127.0.0.1, pass an HTTP smoke test and close cleanly.
securityBoundary: No real authentication or persistent storage is provided in this educational skeleton.
